title: Why God Works Slower Than We Prefer
headline: Why Does God Work Slower Than We Want?
headline_sub: What Is He Developing While You Wait?
tagline: Many blessings arrive later because the man receiving them is still being prepared.
seo_title: Why Does God Make Us Wait? A Devotional for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Many blessings arrive later because the man receiving them is still being prepared. Questions for men in a season of waiting, plus a prayer.
verse_text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

scriptures.text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

blocks.text: Think about a season where God took much longer than you wanted.
Looking back, what was He developing that could not have been developed faster?
Many blessings arrive later because the man receiving them is still being prepared.

items: Why do men struggle with waiting?
What season of waiting are you currently experiencing?
How do you know when waiting is wisdom versus passivity?
What has God produced in previous waiting seasons?
What are you tempted to rush right now?
How might hurry be revealing a trust issue?
Forgive me for measuring growth only by what I can see.
Forgive me for demanding fruit while neglecting the process that produces it.
Help me remain faithful when progress feels slow.

blocks.text: And teach me to trust that You are working beneath the surface even when I cannot see immediate results.

items: And I choose to walk Your pace instead of demanding my own.
